acme_prod_ops: Hey team — noticed a ~65k credit drop overnight. We only ran our daily vectorize job once but credits look like it retried a ton. Can you check?

sarah_support: sorry to hear that, can you paste the job id or a sample task id? and whether a promo / trial was applied to the org?

acme_prod_ops: job_id=job_2027_09_21_9932, org: acme-corp, promo=TRIAL2024 applied on initial upload. free_trial_balance was non-zero before run.

alex_eng_oncall: looking at logs now. I see the parent batch split into 3,200 chunks, then a retry storm for a subset of chunks. retries were issued by the background re-queueer.

alex_eng_oncall: quick log snippet:
```
[2027-09-21T02:12:11Z] chunk_id=ck_119 status=failed reason=rate_limit
[2027-09-21T02:12:11Z] requeue worker=vectorizer-retry requeued_chunk=ck_119 meta={parent_job:job_2027_09_21_9932}
[2027-09-21T02:12:12Z] dispatch to /v1/embeddings headers={"Authorization":"Bearer sk-***","Idempotency-Key":"ck_119"}
[2027-09-21T02:12:12Z] -> 200 OK
```

alex_eng_oncall: but note: the initial request to /v1/batch/vectorize included promo TRIAL2024 in the `X-Promo-Code` header. the retry path uses per-chunk dispatch that only copies auth + idempotency key, not promo header. so retries ended up billed as normal requests.

priya_billing: confirmed. Promo is applied at the root job scope; child chunk requests are billed normally unless promo token is included. Billing logs show the first 1k chunks used promo, then subsequent retries (and duplicate replays) consumed paid credits.

sarah_support: timeline for customer: they kicked off at 02:00 UTC, first failures at 02:12, requeues until 05:20 with backoff. total paid tokens ~64,800 according to billing.

acme_prod_ops: omg, is this a misconfiguration on our side? we didn't change anything.

alex_eng_oncall: no customer change detected. this is a bug in the retryer: when it re-enqueues a failed chunk it doesn't persist promo metadata into the per-chunk dispatch. also we discovered the backoff doubled the retries because the batch-level partial-success logic re-submitted already-acked chunks when the client concurrently requested duplicates — a race that multiplies attempts.

priya_billing: for next steps I can file an immediate credit refund for the paid tokens that should have been covered by the promo. I'll need a billable list of chunk request_ids/timestamps.

alex_eng_oncall: attaching quick repro steps for eng:
1) upload a file that splits into >2000 chunks
2) set client concurrency >= 8 so multiple workers process child chunks
3) force transient rate-limit on some chunk ids (eg iptables drop or inject 429)
4) observe that background requeueer re-dispatches without copying X-Promo-Code header and idempotency is per-chunk only

alex_eng_oncall: minimal diff to fix: persist promotion_token on parent job metadata and include it in per-chunk dispatch. patch should be small — I can push a hotfix to vectorizer-retry in the next 3 hours.

sarah_support: agreed remediation: 1) priya to create a refund for acme-corp for the ~64,800 paid tokens; 2) alex to deploy hotfix to include promo header on retries; 3) temporarily set acme-corp to disable automatic retries for vectorize jobs (so they don't repeat).

priya_billing: refund ticket created: BILL-14512. I'll mark as high priority and add a note: "promo TRIAL2024 should have covered initial and any retry attempts for job_2027_09_21_9932".

acme_prod_ops: thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. please confirm when credits are restored.

infra-bot: deploy job started: vectorizer-retry-hotfix-207890-1 -> staging

alex_eng_oncall: staging tests passed for small and large batches. patch changes: copy promo_token into chunk metadata and ensure per-chunk header includes `X-Promo-Code`. Also tightened dedupe to avoid re-dispatching acked chunks.

alex_eng_oncall: planning rollout to prod in 40m, will monitor error/retry rate and billing anomalies.

sarah_support: once prod patch is live, we'll coordinate with priya to confirm refund and re-run a limited replay for acme (if they want) under promo so they can finish ingestion without cost.

priya_billing: refund processed, pending posting — customer will see a credit within 24-48 hours. ticket BILL-14512 updated. :white_check_mark:

acme_prod_ops: great, can you also add a guard so promo tokens are persisted for any future bulk jobs? we rely on promos for onboarding.

alex_eng_oncall: yes, persisted at job creation and included in all child dispatches going forward. will add an e2e test to avoid regression.

sarah_support: closing loop: requeue hotfix deployed to prod at 2078907600, billing credit initiated. follow up if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:

acme_prod_ops: verified: balance shows refunded credit within the UI. thank you everyone! :pray:
